description: Archives SNCF is a dataset listed in SNCF Open Data, an open data portal of a railway operator, published or maintained by SNCF. Le Service Archives Documentation du Groupe SNCF présente son jeu de données Archives. Afin de refléter au mieux la richesse et la diversité des fonds conservés, cette base de données recense des archives historiques numérisées issues de toutes les périodes de l’histoire de la SNCF depuis la création du chemin de fer en France Plus ... Coverage: France. The portal flags it as a time series. The portal files it under Archives et documentation, Patrimoine. Its keywords are Archives, Service Archives Documentation, Transparence. The portal shows 2023-12-21 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Open Database License (ODbL) (https://data.sncf.com/pages/licence). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support network planning and operations studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-sncf-open-data-portal.
